verdicts.death: put to death, whether by court, by God directly, or by the sword
verdicts.plague: plague, disease, or fire from God, usually on a group
verdicts.captivity: carried captive, bound, or handed to enemies
verdicts.curse: a pronounced curse or standing sentence without immediate death
verdicts.restitution: the wrong was made good under the law of restitution
verdicts.spared: guilty, but spared on repentance, intercession, or by the withdrawal of witnesses
verdicts.reprieve: sentence pronounced but softened, delayed, or stayed
verdicts.temporal: a bounded judgment in this life: sickness, defeat, loss, humiliation
verdicts.unrecorded: the offense and the statute are recorded; scripture does not record the sentence
verdicts.blessed: kept the law, and the blessing scripture records for it
verdicts.deferred: sentence pronounced, carried out after the offender's own death

cases.name: Adam and Eve
cases.charge: Hearkening to the serpent’s doctrine, that ye shall not surely die; and eating the fruit of lies

cases.name: Abel
cases.charge: Bringing the firstlings of his flock and the fat thereof, according to the sacrifice ordained in the garden

cases.name: Cain
cases.charge: Bringing of the fruit of the ground when the sacrificial law required a firstling; refusing correction; and murder of his brother Abel

cases.name: Lamech
cases.charge: Taking two wives, the first in scripture; killing a man and boasting of it; claiming seventy-sevenfold vengeance

cases.name: Enoch
cases.charge: Walking with God three hundred years

cases.name: The sons of God and the giants
cases.charge: The sons of God, the lineage of Adam, taking wives of the daughters of men of the other nations

cases.name: Noah
cases.charge: Doing according to all that God commanded him

cases.name: The generation of the Flood
cases.charge: Despising the commandments; corruption and violence filling the earth after the sons of God mixed with the nations

cases.name: Ham and the curse on Canaan
cases.charge: Seeing the nakedness of his father and not covering him

cases.name: The builders of Babel
cases.charge: Building a city and a tower under Nimrod, to make themselves a name and be one people, lest they be scattered abroad

cases.name: Abraham
cases.charge: Obeying the Lord’s voice; keeping his charge, his commandments, his statutes, and his laws

cases.name: Pharaoh and Abimelech, who took Sarah
cases.charge: Taking another man’s wife into the king’s house

cases.name: Hagar, and the God who seeth
cases.charge: Returning and submitting when the angel sent her back; and calling him Thou God seest me

cases.name: Sodom and Gomorrah
cases.charge: Pride, fulness of bread, abundance of idleness, and abomination; the whole city demanding the strangers

cases.name: Lot
cases.charge: A just man, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked; pressing the strangers into his house and standing at the door

cases.name: Lot’s wife
cases.charge: Looking back toward Sodom against the angel’s command

cases.name: Rebekah and Abraham’s servant
cases.charge: Abraham: making his servant swear to take no wife for Isaac of the daughters of the Canaanites. The servant: asking a sign at the well and worshipping when it came to pass. Rebekah: drawing for the camels, saying, I will go, and covering herself with a vail

cases.name: Jacob, deceiving Isaac for the blessing
cases.charge: Obeying his mother’s voice, who carried the word of the Lord that the elder shall serve the younger; receiving the blessing prophesied before his birth

cases.name: Esau
cases.charge: Despising his birthright; marrying the daughters of Heth against the fathers’ law; purposing to kill his brother

cases.name: Isaac
cases.charge: Dwelling in the land the Lord told him of, and not going down into Egypt in the famine

cases.name: Laban and the changed wages
cases.charge: Changing his hired servant’s wages ten times, and giving the elder daughter in place of the younger

cases.name: Rachel and the stolen teraphim
cases.charge: Stealing her father’s images, and hiding them under her while she sat upon them

cases.name: Jacob at Peniel
cases.charge: I will not let thee go, except thou bless me

cases.name: Shechem son of Hamor
cases.charge: Taking Dinah and defiling her; then seeking to marry into the house he had wronged and make the two peoples one

cases.name: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
cases.charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city in their anger

cases.name: Reuben
cases.charge: Lying with Bilhah, his father’s concubine

cases.name: Joseph’s brothers
cases.charge: Envy, conspiracy to murder, selling their brother to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver, and deceiving their father with the bloodied coat

cases.name: Er and Onan
cases.charge: Er: wickedness in the sight of the Lord. Onan: refusing to raise up seed to his brother

cases.name: Judah and Tamar
cases.charge: Withholding Shelah from his brother’s widow; going in to a woman he took for a harlot by her attire

cases.name: Joseph
cases.charge: Refusing his master’s wife day by day: how can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

cases.name: Potiphar’s wife
cases.charge: Soliciting her husband’s servant day by day, and bearing false witness against him when he fled

cases.name: Job
cases.charge: Perfect and upright, fearing God and eschewing evil; and in all his loss he sinned not with his lips

cases.name: Job’s three friends
cases.charge: Speaking of God the thing that is not right; condemning the righteous, having found no answer

cases.name: Pharaoh of the Exodus
cases.charge: Dealing wisely with Israel: hard bondage, the sons cast into the river, and refusing the Lord’s command through ten plagues

cases.name: Shiphrah and Puah, the midwives
cases.charge: Fearing God and not doing as the king of Egypt commanded them

cases.name: Moses, and the Egyptian in the sand
cases.charge: Slaying the Egyptian that smote his brother, and hiding him in the sand

cases.name: Moses and the uncircumcised son
cases.charge: Neglecting the token of the covenant in his own house, on the road to demand the release of God’s firstborn

cases.name: The magicians of Egypt
cases.charge: Withstanding Moses with their enchantments, and hardening Pharaoh in his refusal

cases.name: Israel at the first Passover
cases.charge: Doing as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron: the lamb, the blood on the door, the flesh roast with fire, the unleavened bread and bitter herbs

cases.name: Amalek
cases.charge: Smiting the hindmost, the feeble and faint and weary, when Israel came out of Egypt; and he feared not God

cases.name: Moses
cases.charge: Refusing to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter; faithful in all the Lord’s house; very meek, above all the men upon the face of the earth

cases.name: The manna hoarders
cases.charge: Keeping manna overnight; going out to gather on the Sabbath

cases.name: Bezaleel and Aholiab
cases.charge: Making all that the Lord commanded, and no more; and teaching others to do it

cases.name: Aaron and Israel at the golden calf
cases.charge: Idolatry within weeks of the covenant: the spirit of Egypt still in Israel

cases.name: The sons of Levi at the golden calf
cases.charge: Answering, Who is on the Lord’s side? and executing the sentence on their own brethren

cases.name: Nadab and Abihu
cases.charge: Offering strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not

cases.name: The blasphemer in the camp
cases.charge: Blaspheming the Name of the Lord, and cursing, in a quarrel

cases.name: The complainers at Taberah and the lusters at Kibroth-hattaavah
cases.charge: Complaining against the Lord after the deliverance, and lusting after the food of Egypt behind the mixed multitude

cases.name: Eldad and Medad
cases.charge: Prophesying in the camp when the spirit rested on them, and being defended by Moses

cases.name: Aaron and Miriam
cases.charge: Speaking against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman, and claiming an equal standing: hath he not spoken also by us?

cases.name: The ten spies
cases.charge: Bringing up an evil report of the land the Lord had given; making the congregation to murmur

cases.name: Caleb and Joshua
cases.charge: Wholly following the Lord when ten spies and the whole congregation would not

cases.name: The generation that died in the wilderness
cases.charge: Tempting the Lord ten times; unbelief at Kadesh-barnea; a captain to return into Egypt

cases.name: The man gathering sticks on the Sabbath
cases.charge: Gathering sticks on the Sabbath day to kindle a fire: the presumptuous sin

cases.name: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
cases.charge: Rebellion against the men the Lord chose; seeking the priesthood also

cases.name: The congregation, the day after Korah
cases.charge: Murmuring that Moses and Aaron had killed the people of the Lord

cases.name: Moses at the waters of Meribah
cases.charge: Failing to sanctify the Lord before the people: must we fetch you water out of this rock?

cases.name: Israel and the fiery serpents
cases.charge: Speaking against God and against Moses; loathing the bread from heaven

cases.name: Sihon and Og
cases.charge: Refusing Israel passage on the king’s highway and coming out to battle against them

cases.name: Balaam
cases.charge: Divination for hire; counselling Balak to make Israel curse itself through the women of Moab

cases.name: Israel at Baal-peor
cases.charge: Whoredom with the daughters of Moab, eating the sacrifices of their gods, and joining themselves unto Baal-peor

cases.name: The Midianites, in the matter of Peor
cases.charge: Beguiling Israel with their wiles into fornication and the worship of Baal-peor

cases.name: Phinehas
cases.charge: Zealous for his God at Peor; making an atonement for the children of Israel

cases.name: Zimri and Cozbi
cases.charge: Bringing a Midianite woman into the camp in the sight of the congregation, while the plague ran

cases.name: The daughters of Zelophehad
cases.charge: Asking rightly for their father’s inheritance, and marrying within their tribe as commanded

cases.name: Rahab
cases.charge: Receiving the spies with peace, and believing that the Lord had given Israel the land

cases.name: Achan
cases.charge: Israel trespassed in the accursed thing: Achan saw, coveted, took of the devoted spoil of Jericho, and hid it in his tent

cases.name: The Gibeonites, and Israel’s oath
cases.charge: Obtaining a covenant by fraud; and Israel making it without asking counsel at the mouth of the Lord

cases.name: The five kings at Makkedah
cases.charge: Confederating against Gibeon for making peace with Israel

cases.name: Othniel and Achsah
cases.charge: Taking Kirjath-sepher at Caleb’s word; and asking for the springs as well as the land

cases.name: Adoni-bezek
cases.charge: Mutilating seventy kings and feeding them under his table

cases.name: Jabez
cases.charge: Calling on the God of Israel to bless him indeed, enlarge his coast, keep His hand with him, and keep him from evil

cases.name: Israel in the days of the Judges
cases.charge: Making leagues with the inhabitants of the land; marrying their daughters and serving their gods; every man doing that which was right in his own eyes

cases.name: Eglon king of Moab
cases.charge: Possessing the city of palm trees and holding Israel in servitude eighteen years

cases.name: Jabin and Sisera
cases.charge: Mightily oppressing Israel twenty years with nine hundred chariots of iron

cases.name: Deborah
cases.charge: Judging Israel under the palm tree; delivering the commandment of the Lord to Barak, and going up with him

cases.name: Barak
cases.charge: Going down from Tabor at the word of the Lord against nine hundred chariots of iron; and going only on condition that Deborah went

cases.name: Jael
cases.charge: Blessed above women in the tent: the nail, the hammer, and Sisera

cases.name: Gideon
cases.charge: Throwing down his father’s altar of Baal; going against Midian with three hundred, as the Lord said

cases.name: The men of Succoth and Penuel
cases.charge: Refusing bread to the army of the Lord, faint yet pursuing, and upbraiding them with it

cases.name: Gideon’s ephod
cases.charge: Making an ephod of the golden earrings of the spoil, and putting it in Ophrah; all Israel going a whoring after it

cases.name: Abimelech son of Gideon
cases.charge: Slaying his seventy brethren upon one stone with silver out of the house of Baal-berith; making himself king at Shechem

cases.name: Jephthah’s vow
cases.charge: A vow uttered before the Lord, and paid in his only daughter

cases.name: Manoah and his wife
cases.charge: Asking, how shall we order the child? and observing all that the angel commanded

cases.name: Samson
cases.charge: Lusting after Philistine women: a wife at Timnath against his parents’ counsel, a harlot at Gaza, and Delilah, to whom he told all his heart

cases.name: Micah’s idols and the tribe of Dan
cases.charge: A house of gods, a hired Levite, and a tribe that stole both and set up the graven image in Dan

cases.name: The men of Gibeah, and Benjamin
cases.charge: Sons of Belial demanding the man; the gang rape and death of his concubine; and a tribe that would not deliver up the guilty

cases.name: Ruth and Boaz
cases.charge: Ruth: cleaving to Naomi and joining herself under Israel and Israel’s God. Boaz: the law of the land conducted at the gate before witnesses, and love thy neighbour as thyself

cases.name: Hannah
cases.charge: Pouring out her soul before the Lord, vowing a son to him, and lending him to the Lord as long as he liveth

cases.name: Eli and his sons
cases.charge: Sons of Belial in the priest’s office, strong-arming the offering of the Lord and lying with the women at the tabernacle door; and a father who honoured his sons above the Lord

cases.name: The Philistines and the captured ark
cases.charge: Setting the ark of God in the house of Dagon, and carrying it from city to city seven months

cases.name: The men of Beth-shemesh
cases.charge: Looking into the ark of the Lord

cases.name: Samuel
cases.charge: Speak, Lord; for thy servant heareth: telling Eli every whit and hiding nothing; and an accounting no man could contradict, whose ox have I taken?

cases.name: Joel and Abiah, the sons of Samuel
cases.charge: Turning aside after lucre, taking bribes, and perverting judgment in the seat of the judge

cases.name: Israel asking for a king
cases.charge: Rejecting the Lord, that he should not reign over them, to be like all the nations

cases.name: King Saul
cases.charge: Offering the burnt offering himself at Gilgal; sparing Agag and the best of the spoil; and stubbornness, which is as iniquity and idolatry

cases.name: David
cases.charge: A man after the Lord’s own heart: twice sparing the Lord’s anointed, leaving vengeance with the Lord, and repenting when he fell

cases.name: Saul’s rash oath, and the people at the blood
cases.charge: A strange oath that distressed the army; the people eating flesh with the blood; the king ready to kill the son who had wrought the salvation

cases.name: Agag king of the Amalekites
cases.charge: The sword that made women childless; and the sworn war with Amalek from generation to generation

cases.name: Goliath of Gath
cases.charge: Defying the armies of the living God, morning and evening, forty days

cases.name: Jonathan
cases.charge: Stripping himself of his robe for the man whom the Lord would make king; standing between his father and David’s innocent blood; thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee

cases.name: Saul and Doeg at Nob
cases.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an Edomite’s report

cases.name: Nabal
cases.charge: Railing on the Lord’s anointed and his men who had been a wall to his shepherds; who is David?

cases.name: Abigail
cases.charge: Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: keeping David from shedding blood and avenging himself with his own hand

cases.name: Saul and the witch of Endor
cases.charge: Seeking a woman with a familiar spirit after he had himself put them out of the land

cases.name: The Amalekite who claimed to kill Saul
cases.charge: Claiming to have slain the Lord’s anointed, and bringing his crown for a reward

cases.name: Joab
cases.charge: Shedding the blood of war in peace: Abner in the gate of Hebron, and Amasa with a kiss

cases.name: Mephibosheth
cases.charge: What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am? and, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace

cases.name: Baanah and Rechab
cases.charge: Murder of Ish-bosheth on his bed at noon, and carrying his head to David for a reward

cases.name: Uzzah and the ark
cases.charge: Putting forth his hand to the ark of God, which was carried on a new cart and not on the shoulders of the Levites

cases.name: Obed-edom the Gittite
cases.charge: Keeping the ark of God in his house three months, after it had killed Uzzah

cases.name: Michal
cases.charge: Despising the king in her heart for dancing before the ark; how glorious was the king of Israel to day

cases.name: David and Bathsheba
cases.charge: Adultery with the wife of Uriah, and setting Uriah up to be murdered on the battlefield to cover it

cases.name: Uriah the Hittite
cases.charge: The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; shall I then go into mine house? as thou livest, I will not do this thing

cases.name: Amnon
cases.charge: Forcing his sister Tamar, then hating her and putting her out

cases.name: Absalom
cases.charge: Murder of Amnon; stealing the hearts of the men of Israel; conspiracy and rebellion against the king his father; lying with his father’s concubines before all Israel

cases.name: Ahithophel
cases.charge: Treason against David; counselling Absalom to lie with his father’s concubines; asking for twelve thousand men to smite the king; suicide

cases.name: Ittai the Gittite
cases.charge: As the Lord liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be

cases.name: Shimei son of Gera
cases.charge: Cursing the king and casting stones at him: come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial

cases.name: Barzillai the Gileadite
cases.charge: Providing the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man

cases.name: Sheba son of Bichri
cases.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse

cases.name: Rizpah
cases.charge: Spreading sackcloth upon the rock from the beginning of harvest until water dropped out of heaven, suffering neither the birds by day nor the beasts by night to touch them

cases.name: Saul’s house and the Gibeonites
cases.charge: Breaking the oath Israel sware to the Gibeonites by slaying them in zeal for Israel and Judah

cases.name: David’s numbering of the people
cases.charge: Numbering Israel and Judah against Joab’s counsel; seventy thousand men dead of the pestilence

cases.name: Adonijah
cases.charge: Exalting himself, saying, I will be king; and after his pardon, asking for Abishag the Shunammite

cases.name: Solomon at Gibeon
cases.charge: Asking for an understanding heart to judge thy people, and not long life, nor riches, nor the life of his enemies

cases.name: The two women before Solomon
cases.charge: Two harlots, one living child, and a claim that only a sword could sort out

cases.name: King Solomon
cases.charge: Loving many strange women of the nations the Lord had forbidden; multiplying wives against the law of the king; building high places for Chemosh and Molech

cases.name: Rehoboam
cases.charge: Forsaking the counsel of the old men for the young men he grew up with; and forsaking the law of the Lord when the kingdom was established

cases.name: Jeroboam son of Nebat
cases.charge: Two calves of gold, behold thy gods, O Israel; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

cases.name: Amaziah the priest of Bethel
cases.charge: Forbidding Amos to prophesy at the king’s chapel; sending to Jeroboam that Amos had conspired against him

cases.name: The man of God from Judah
cases.charge: Turning back to eat bread and drink water at Bethel against the word of the Lord, on the word of a prophet who lied

cases.name: The old prophet of Beth-el
cases.charge: Lying in the name of the Lord, claiming an angel’s word, to turn a prophet from his charge

cases.name: Baasha
cases.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being exalted out of the dust to destroy Jeroboam’s house

cases.name: Zimri
cases.charge: Conspiring against his master Elah as he drank himself drunk; slaying all the house of Baasha; seven days on the throne

cases.name: Omri
cases.charge: Doing worse than all that were before him; walking in all the way of Jeroboam

cases.name: Ahab
cases.charge: Marrying Jezebel and serving Baal above all the kings before him; letting go Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction; selling himself to work wickedness

cases.name: Jezebel
cases.charge: Cutting off the prophets of the Lord; feeding eight hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the groves at her table; whoredoms and witchcrafts

cases.name: Hiel the Bethelite
cases.charge: Building Jericho again under the oath Joshua adjured before the Lord

cases.name: Elijah
cases.charge: As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand: shutting the heaven by prayer, standing alone against eight hundred and fifty at Carmel, and running before the king in the hand of the Lord

cases.name: The widow of Zarephath
cases.charge: Making the man of God a little cake first, out of the last handful of meal, according to the word

cases.name: Obadiah, who hid the prophets
cases.charge: Taking an hundred prophets and hiding them by fifty in a cave, and feeding them with bread and water, while governor of Ahab’s house

cases.name: The prophets of Baal at Carmel
cases.charge: Prophesying in the name of Baal and eating at Jezebel’s table; crying from morning to noon to a god that could not answer

cases.name: Elisha
cases.charge: Leaving the oxen and following; asking a double portion of the spirit; and refusing Naaman’s reward, as the Lord liveth, before whom I stand

cases.name: Ben-hadad and the Syrians at Aphek
cases.charge: Saying, the Lord is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys

cases.name: The man who refused the prophetic command
cases.charge: Refusing to smite the prophet when commanded in the word of the Lord

cases.name: Jezebel and Naboth’s vineyard
cases.charge: Letters in the king’s name under the king’s seal; a fast, two sons of Belial, and a stoning, to take a man’s inheritance

cases.name: Micaiah the son of Imlah
cases.charge: As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak: against four hundred prophets, two kings, a slap, and a prison

cases.name: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah, and the four hundred prophets
cases.charge: Horns of iron and a lying spirit: prophesying victory at Ramoth-gilead in the name of the Lord, and smiting Micaiah on the cheek

cases.name: Ahaziah of Israel
cases.charge: Sending to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, as though there were not a God in Israel

cases.name: The young mockers of Bethel
cases.charge: Mocking the prophet of the Lord: go up, thou bald head

cases.name: The prophet’s widow, and the pot of oil
cases.charge: Borrowing empty vessels of her neighbours, not a few, shutting the door, and pouring, as the prophet said

cases.name: The Shunammite woman
cases.charge: Constraining the man of God to eat bread, and building him a little chamber on the wall with a bed, a table, a stool, and a candlestick

cases.name: Naaman the Syrian
cases.charge: Going down and dipping himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God, after his anger

cases.name: Gehazi
cases.charge: Running after Naaman to take what his master refused; lying to Naaman and then to the prophet’s face

cases.name: The lord on whose hand the king leaned
cases.charge: Doubting the word of the Lord by Elisha in the famine of Samaria: if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be?

cases.name: Hazael king of Syria
cases.charge: Smothering his master with a wet cloth to take the throne, and doing to Israel the evil Elisha wept over

cases.name: Jehu
cases.charge: Executing the house of Ahab and destroying Baal out of Israel, and then not departing from the golden calves at Bethel and Dan; taking no heed to walk in the law of the Lord with all his heart

cases.name: Athaliah
cases.charge: Destroying all the seed royal of the house of Judah to reign herself; crying treason when the rightful king was crowned

cases.name: Jehoahaz of Israel
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord and following the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, departing not therefrom; beseeching the Lord under the oppression of Syria, and not departing from the sins of the house of Jeroboam when the saviour came

cases.name: Jehoash of Israel and the arrows
cases.charge: Doing evil and departing not from the sins of Jeroboam; smiting the ground thrice with the arrows and staying, when the man of God had put his hands on his hands

cases.name: Jeroboam the son of Joash
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord forty-one years; departing not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat

cases.name: Hosea the prophet
cases.charge: Taking a wife of whoredoms at the Lord’s command as a sign against Israel; prophesying the scattering and the return

cases.name: Menahem king of Israel
cases.charge: Ripping up all the women with child in Tiphsah; buying Assyria with a thousand talents of silver exacted from Israel

cases.name: Hoshea, last king of Israel
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord, though not as the kings before him; conspiring with So king of Egypt and withholding the tribute

cases.name: The captivity of Israel (the northern kingdom)
cases.charge: Fearing other gods; walking in the statutes of the heathen; two calves, a grove, the host of heaven, Baal; sons and daughters through the fire; divination and enchantments; selling themselves to do evil

cases.name: Hezekiah
cases.charge: Trusting in the Lord God of Israel, so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah; cleaving to him and keeping his commandments; breaking the brasen serpent; opening the doors of the house of the Lord and keeping the passover

cases.name: Shebna the treasurer
cases.charge: Hewing himself a sepulchre on high in the rock, as if Jerusalem were his to be buried in; a shame to his lord’s house

cases.name: Sennacherib and Rabshakeh
cases.charge: Reproaching the living God; setting the Holy One of Israel among the gods of the nations that could not save

cases.name: Hezekiah and the ambassadors of Babylon
cases.charge: Rendering not again according to the benefit done unto him, for his heart was lifted up; shewing all his treasures to the men of Babylon

cases.name: Isaiah
cases.charge: Here am I; send me: a prophet unto a people whose heart was made fat, who walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign, and stood beside the king when Assyria blasphemed

cases.name: Manasseh
cases.charge: Building again the high places his father destroyed; altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the Lord’s house; his children through the fire; observing times, enchantments, witchcraft, familiar spirits and wizards; a carved image in the house of God; Jerusalem filled with innocent blood from one end to another

cases.name: Amon
cases.charge: Sacrificing to all the carved images his father had made; humbling not himself as his father had humbled himself, but trespassing more and more

cases.name: Josiah
cases.charge: A tender heart at the reading of the book; rending his clothes; turning to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses

cases.name: Jehoahaz (Shallum) of Judah
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord according to all that his fathers had done

cases.name: Jehoiachin (Coniah)
cases.charge: Doing evil as his father Jehoiakim had done; a signet plucked from the Lord’s right hand

cases.name: Asa in his first years
cases.charge: Taking away the altars of the strange gods, the high places, the images and the groves; commanding Judah to seek the Lord and to do the law; crying to the Lord against a thousand thousand Ethiopians

cases.name: Asa in his latter years
cases.charge: Relying on the king of Syria and not on the Lord; putting the seer in a prison house for the rebuke; in his disease seeking not to the Lord, but to the physicians

cases.name: Jehoshaphat
cases.charge: Walking in the first ways of his father David and seeking not unto Baalim; sending princes and Levites with the book of the law to teach in all the cities of Judah; and setting singers before the army

cases.name: Jehoshaphat’s alliances
cases.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab and going up with him to Ramoth-gilead against the word of the prophet; joining himself with Ahaziah to make ships

cases.name: Jehoram of Judah
cases.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword as soon as he was strengthened; walking in the way of the house of Ahab, for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

cases.name: Ahaziah of Judah
cases.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly; going down to Jezreel to see Joram

cases.name: Jehoiada the priest
cases.charge: Hiding the king’s son in the house of God six years; crowning him with the testimony; making a covenant that they should be the Lord’s people; doing good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house

cases.name: Joash of Judah
cases.charge: Hearkening to the princes after Jehoiada’s death; leaving the house of the Lord to serve groves and idols; stoning Zechariah the son of Jehoiada in the court of the house of the Lord

cases.name: Amaziah
cases.charge: Bringing home the gods of the children of Seir, setting them up to be his gods, and bowing down before them; threatening the prophet sent to him; provoking Israel to his hurt

cases.name: Uzziah
cases.charge: Going into the temple of the Lord to burn incense upon the altar of incense, which appertaineth not unto the king but to the priests the sons of Aaron; and raging at the priests who withstood him

cases.name: Jotham
cases.charge: Preparing his ways before the Lord his God; doing according to all that his father Uzziah did, howbeit he entered not into the temple of the Lord

cases.name: Ahaz
cases.charge: Molten images for Baalim; burning his children in the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; hiring Assyria with the treasure of the Lord’s house; sacrificing to the gods of Damascus that smote him; cutting the vessels in pieces and shutting up the doors of the house of the Lord

cases.name: Josiah at Megiddo
cases.charge: Going out against Necho king of Egypt who had no quarrel with him; hearkening not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God; disguising himself to fight

cases.name: Zedekiah
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord; humbling not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord; rebelling against Nebuchadnezzar who had made him swear by God; stiffening his neck and hardening his heart from turning unto the Lord God of Israel

cases.name: The captivity of Judah
cases.charge: All the chief of the priests and the people transgressing very much after all the abominations of the heathen, and polluting the house of the Lord; mocking the messengers of God, despising his words, and misusing his prophets, till there was no remedy; the land’s sabbaths not kept

cases.name: Nineveh under Jonah
cases.charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord; and turning every one from his evil way, and from the violence that was in their hands

cases.name: Jeremiah
cases.charge: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; be not afraid of their faces: speaking all that was commanded, though the word was a burning fire shut up in his bones and his own familiars watched for his halting

cases.name: Pashur the son of Immer
cases.charge: Smiting the prophet of the Lord and putting him in the stocks in the high gate of Benjamin; prophesying lies

cases.name: Jehoiakim
cases.charge: Building his house by unrighteousness and his chambers by wrong, using his neighbour’s service without wages; eyes and heart set on covetousness, innocent blood, oppression and violence; slaying Urijah the prophet; cutting the roll of the Lord’s words with a penknife and burning it

cases.name: Hananiah the son of Azur
cases.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord, and breaking the yoke from off Jeremiah’s neck before the priests and all the people

cases.name: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
cases.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord among the captives at Babylon; committing villainy in Israel and adultery with their neighbours’ wives

cases.name: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
cases.charge: Sending letters in his own name from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks as a madman; prophesying when the Lord sent him not, and causing the people to trust in a lie

cases.name: Jonadab and the Rechabites
cases.charge: Obeying the voice of Jonadab their father in all that he charged them: drinking no wine, building no house, sowing no seed, planting no vineyard, but dwelling in tents all their days

cases.name: Baruch the scribe
cases.charge: Writing from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord upon a roll, reading it in the house of the Lord and before the princes, and writing it again after the king burned it

cases.name: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian
cases.charge: Going out to the king in the gate of Benjamin and telling him the princes had done evil to Jeremiah, then drawing the prophet up out of the dungeon of mire with old cast clouts and rotten rags under his armholes

cases.name: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah
cases.charge: Smiting Gedaliah the governor with the sword at his own table, and all the Jews and Chaldeans with him at Mizpah; slaying seventy of the eighty men coming with offerings to the house of the Lord and casting them into the pit; carrying the residue captive toward the Ammonites

cases.name: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
cases.charge: Asking Jeremiah to pray for the way wherein they should walk, swearing to obey the voice of the Lord whether it were good or evil, and then calling the prophet a liar and going into Egypt against the commandment; burning incense to the queen of heaven in the land of Egypt

cases.name: Moab and Ammon
cases.charge: Moab: magnifying himself against the Lord, trusting in his works and his treasures, and skipping for joy at the derision of Israel. Ammon: saying Aha against the sanctuary when it was profaned, against the land of Israel when it was desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity

cases.name: Babylon, the lady of kingdoms
cases.charge: Shewing no mercy to the people the Lord was wroth with and gave into her hand; laying her yoke very heavily upon the ancient; saying in her heart, I am, and none else beside me; trusting in her wickedness, her wisdom, and the multitude of her sorceries

cases.name: The elders with idols in the temple (Ezekiel 8)
cases.charge: The image of jealousy at the gate; seventy ancients with censers before creeping things and idols portrayed on the wall in the dark, saying, the Lord seeth us not; women weeping for Tammuz; twenty-five men with their backs to the temple worshipping the sun toward the east

cases.name: Pelatiah and the princes at the east gate
cases.charge: Devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in the city: it is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh

cases.name: Edom, in the day of his brother
cases.charge: Standing on the other side in the day that strangers carried away Jacob captive, and being as one of them; rejoicing over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; entering the gate, laying hands on the substance, standing in the crossway to cut off those that escaped, and delivering up those that remained

cases.name: The prince of Tyre
cases.charge: Saying, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; setting his heart as the heart of God because of the riches gotten by his wisdom and his traffick

cases.name: Pharaoh-hophra and Egypt
cases.charge: Saying, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself; being a staff of reed to the house of Israel that brake when they leaned upon it

cases.name: The shepherds of Israel
cases.charge: Feeding themselves and not the flock; eating the fat and clothing themselves with the wool; not strengthening the diseased, healing the sick, binding up the broken, bringing again the driven away, or seeking the lost; ruling with force and with cruelty

cases.name: Jonah
cases.charge: Rising up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord instead of going to Nineveh to cry against it

cases.name: Nineveh under Nahum
cases.charge: A bloody city, full of lies and robbery, whose prey departeth not; the dwelling of the lions that filled his holes with prey; the wicked counsellor that imagineth evil against the Lord

cases.name: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
cases.charge: Weakening the hands of the people of Judah and troubling them in building; hiring counsellors against them to frustrate their purpose; writing accusations against Jerusalem to the king, and making the work cease by force and power

cases.name: Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest
cases.charge: Obeying the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet; humbling themselves, fearing before the Lord, and rising up to work in the house of the Lord of hosts

cases.name: Ezra
cases.charge: Preparing his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments; proclaiming a fast at the river Ahava, and being ashamed to ask the king for soldiers after saying the hand of God is upon all them that seek him

cases.name: The returned exiles who married strange wives
cases.charge: Not separating themselves from the people of the lands; taking their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed mingled itself with the people of those lands; the princes and rulers chief in the trespass

cases.name: Nehemiah
cases.charge: Fasting and praying before the God of heaven for the remnant; building the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand; taking no governor’s bread; forbidding usury; shutting the gates on the Sabbath; remember me, O my God, for good

cases.name: Sanballat, Geshem, and Noadiah
cases.charge: Laughing the work to scorn; conspiring to fight against Jerusalem; sending four times to draw Nehemiah to the plain of Ono to do him mischief; an open letter charging rebellion; hiring Shemaiah and the prophetess Noadiah to put him in fear

cases.name: The nobles who exacted usury of their brethren
cases.charge: Exacting usury every one of his brother; taking their lands, vineyards, oliveyards, and houses, and bringing their sons and daughters into bondage for debt

cases.name: Eliashib and Tobiah the Ammonite
cases.charge: Preparing for Tobiah the Ammonite a great chamber in the court of the house of God, where the offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the Levites had been laid; a grandson of the high priest son in law to Sanballat the Horonite

cases.name: The Sabbath traders of Jerusalem and Tyre
cases.charge: Treading winepresses on the Sabbath, bringing in sheaves, lading asses with wine, grapes, and figs, and bringing burdens into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; men of Tyre selling fish and all manner of ware on the Sabbath to the children of Judah

cases.name: Bigthan and Teresh
cases.charge: Two of the king’s chamberlains, of those which kept the door, being wroth and seeking to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus

cases.name: Haman the Agagite
cases.charge: Thinking scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone, and seeking to destroy all the Jews throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus; offering ten thousand talents of silver for their destruction; making a gallows fifty cubits high for Mordecai

cases.name: Mordecai and Esther
cases.charge: Mordecai: bowing not to Haman, nor doing him reverence. Esther: gathering the Jews to fast three days, and going in to the king not according to the law: if I perish, I perish

cases.name: Daniel
cases.charge: Purposing in his heart not to defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat nor with the wine which he drank; kneeling and praying three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem, as he did aforetime, after the decree was signed

cases.name: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
cases.charge: Not serving the king’s gods nor worshipping the golden image which he had set up; not careful to answer the king in this matter: but if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods

cases.name: The Chaldeans who accused the Jews
cases.charge: Coming near and accusing the Jews to the king, that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego regarded not the king, served not his gods, nor worshipped the golden image, to have them cast into the furnace for keeping the second commandment

cases.name: Nebuchadnezzar
cases.charge: Pride: is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

cases.name: Belshazzar
cases.charge: Drinking wine from the gold and silver vessels taken out of the temple of the house of God at Jerusalem, with his princes, his wives, and his concubines, and praising the gods of gold, silver, brass, iron, wood, and stone; lifting himself up against the Lord of heaven, having known how his father was humbled

cases.name: Daniel’s accusers
cases.charge: Seeking occasion against Daniel and finding none; procuring a decree by the law of the Medes and Persians that no man petition any god or man for thirty days save the king, to take him in the law of his God; assembling to find him praying and pressing the king to cast him to the lions

cases.name: The priests who despised the Name
cases.charge: Offering polluted bread upon the altar, and the blind, the lame, and the sick for sacrifice; saying the table of the Lord is contemptible and its service a weariness; departing out of the way, causing many to stumble at the law, and being partial in the law

cases.name: Judah robbing God in tithes and offerings
cases.charge: Going away from the Lord’s ordinances and not keeping them; robbing God in tithes and offerings, so that there was no meat in His house and the Levites fled every one to his field

cases.name: Tobit
cases.charge: Walking in truth and justice all his days; alms, tithes, and burying the dead of his people at the risk of his own life

cases.name: Aman, who ensnared Achiacharus
cases.charge: Treachery against the man who brought him up

cases.name: Holofernes
cases.charge: Making Nebuchadnezzar a god; blasphemy against the God of Israel; lust and drunkenness

cases.name: Judith
cases.charge: A widow who feared God greatly, fasting all the days of her widowhood; going out to Holofernes in the name of the Lord

cases.name: Susanna
cases.charge: Choosing to fall into the hands of the elders rather than sin in the sight of the Lord

cases.name: The two elders who accused Susanna
cases.charge: Attempted adultery by extortion; false witness against an innocent woman

cases.name: The priests of Bel
cases.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

cases.name: The Hellenizers who forsook the holy covenant
cases.charge: Covenanting with the heathen; removing circumcision; profaning the Sabbath; sacrificing to idols

cases.name: Apollonius
cases.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive

cases.name: Antiochus Epiphanes
cases.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

cases.name: Mattathias
cases.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king’s commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

cases.name: The Jew who sacrificed at Modin
cases.charge: Sacrificing on the heathen altar at the king’s command

cases.name: Judas Maccabeus
cases.charge: Going to battle with prayer and the law, keeping the ordinances of war, and cleansing the sanctuary

cases.name: Alcimus
cases.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court

cases.name: Nicanor
cases.charge: Blasphemy against the temple; breaking covenant with Judas; resolving to attack on the Sabbath

cases.name: Tryphon
cases.charge: Taking Jonathan the high priest by treachery under a covenant of friendship; slaying him and the young king Antiochus

cases.name: Ptolemy the son of Abubus
cases.charge: Murdering Simon the high priest and two of his sons at a banquet in his own castle

cases.name: Onias the high priest
cases.charge: Godliness and hatred of wickedness, so that the laws were kept very well and the city lived in peace

cases.name: Heliodorus
cases.charge: Attempting to plunder the temple treasury

cases.name: Simon the governor of the temple
cases.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

cases.name: Jason the high priest
cases.charge: Buying the priesthood; setting up a Greek gymnasium; drawing his countrymen to heathen customs

cases.name: Menelaus
cases.charge: Buying the priesthood over Jason; stealing the temple vessels; procuring the murder of Onias; bribing his way past the king’s judgment

cases.name: Andronicus
cases.charge: Murder of Onias the high priest under a sworn assurance

cases.name: Lysimachus
cases.charge: Sacrilege: robbing the temple with Menelaus’ consent

cases.name: Eleazar the scribe
cases.charge: Choosing to die gloriously rather than eat swine’s flesh, or pretend to, at ninety years old

cases.name: The seven brethren and their mother
cases.charge: Refusing to taste swine’s flesh under torture, seven times over, in hope of the resurrection

cases.name: Timotheus
cases.charge: Gathering the heathen to root out the Jews; a second campaign after being once spared

cases.name: The men of Joppa
cases.charge: Drowning two hundred of the Jews that dwelt among them, under a pretence of peace

cases.name: Judas’ soldiers with idol tokens under their coats
cases.charge: Carrying things consecrated to idols into battle

cases.name: Joseph, the husband of Mary
cases.charge: A just man; doing as the angel of the Lord bade him, four times, without a word recorded

cases.name: Herod the Great and the children of Bethlehem
cases.charge: Slaying all the male children of Bethlehem from two years old and under

cases.name: John the Baptist
cases.charge: Telling a king it is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife

cases.name: The centurion of Capernaum
cases.charge: Loving the nation and building the synagogue; not counting himself worthy that the Lord should come under his roof: speak the word only

cases.name: Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum
cases.charge: Not repenting after the mighty works done in them

cases.name: The Canaanite woman
cases.charge: Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table

cases.name: The wicked husbandmen
cases.charge: Beating and killing the servants sent for the fruit, and killing the heir to seize the inheritance

cases.name: The marriage of the king’s son
cases.charge: Making light of the call, and killing the servants who brought it

cases.name: The scribes and Pharisees
cases.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows’ houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

cases.name: Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets
cases.charge: Killing the prophets and stoning them that are sent; not knowing the time of her visitation

cases.name: Peter’s denial
cases.charge: Denying Christ three times with cursing and swearing

cases.name: The chief priests, and the watch at the sepulchre
cases.charge: Paying the soldiers large money to report a lie about the resurrection

cases.name: The woman with the issue of blood
cases.charge: Believing that if she might but touch his clothes she should be whole

cases.name: Herod Antipas and Herodias
cases.charge: Taking his brother’s wife; beheading John for saying so

cases.name: The rich young ruler
cases.charge: Going away sorrowful, because he had great possessions

cases.name: The widow and her two mites
cases.charge: Casting in all that she had, even all her living

cases.name: Barabbas
cases.charge: Insurrection and murder

cases.name: Joseph of Arimathaea
cases.charge: Going in boldly unto Pilate and craving the body; and not having consented to the counsel and deed of them

cases.name: Zacharias
cases.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign

cases.name: Zacharias and Elisabeth
cases.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless

cases.name: Mary, the mother of Jesus
cases.charge: Be it unto me according to thy word; blessed is she that believed

cases.name: Simeon and Anna
cases.charge: Just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel; a widow who departed not from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day

cases.name: Nazareth, his own country
cases.charge: Being offended at him; seeking to cast him down the hill

cases.name: The Samaritan village, and the sons of thunder
cases.charge: Refusing to receive him because his face was toward Jerusalem; James and John asking for fire from heaven

cases.name: Mary of Bethany
cases.charge: Sitting at his feet to hear his word; anointing his body aforehand to the burying

cases.name: The barren fig tree
cases.charge: Cumbering the ground three years without fruit

cases.name: The Samaritan leper who returned
cases.charge: One of ten: turning back to glorify God with a loud voice, and giving thanks at his feet

cases.name: Zacchaeus
cases.charge: Extortion as chief of the publicans

cases.name: Pontius Pilate
cases.charge: Condemning a man he had three times pronounced innocent

cases.name: The penitent thief
cases.charge: Robbery, under sentence of crucifixion

cases.name: The traders in the temple
cases.charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves

cases.name: Nicodemus
cases.charge: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?; and bringing a hundred pound weight of myrrh and aloes

cases.name: The woman taken in adultery
cases.charge: Adultery, in the very act

cases.name: Caiaphas and the council
cases.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

cases.name: Judas Iscariot
cases.charge: Theft from the common purse; betraying innocent blood for thirty pieces of silver

cases.name: Barnabas
cases.charge: Selling his land and laying the money at the apostles’ feet; a good man, full of the Holy Ghost and of faith

cases.name: Ananias and Sapphira
cases.charge: Vowing a possession to the Lord, keeping back part of the price, and lying to the Holy Ghost about it

cases.name: Stephen
cases.charge: Full of faith and of the Holy Ghost; a face like an angel before the council; forgiving those who stoned him

cases.name: The false witnesses against Stephen
cases.charge: Suborning witnesses and stirring up the council against a man they could not answer

cases.name: Saul of Tarsus
cases.charge: Persecuting the church; consenting to Stephen’s death; compelling the saints to blaspheme

cases.name: Simon Magus
cases.charge: Offering money for the gift of the Holy Ghost

cases.name: Ananias of Damascus
cases.charge: Going to the street called Straight and putting his hands on the man who had come to bind him: Brother Saul

cases.name: Dorcas (Tabitha)
cases.charge: Full of good works and almsdeeds which she did; the coats and garments she made for the widows

cases.name: Cornelius
cases.charge: A devout man, one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway

cases.name: Peter at Antioch
cases.charge: Dissembling: withdrawing from the Gentiles for fear of them of the circumcision

cases.name: James the brother of John
cases.charge: Killed with the sword by Herod, to please the people

cases.name: Herod Agrippa
cases.charge: Accepting worship due to God alone

cases.name: Elymas the sorcerer
cases.charge: Withstanding the apostles; seeking to turn the deputy from the faith

cases.name: They that troubled the churches with circumcision
cases.charge: Preaching another gospel, subverting souls with a commandment the apostles never gave

cases.name: Lydia
cases.charge: A seller of purple who worshipped God; whose heart the Lord opened; who constrained the apostles to abide in her house

cases.name: The magistrates of Philippi
cases.charge: Beating and imprisoning uncondemned Romans on the word of a mob

cases.name: The Philippian jailer
cases.charge: Believing on the Lord with all his house the same night; washing the stripes of the men he had put in the stocks

cases.name: The Bereans
cases.charge: Receiving the word with all readiness of mind, and searching the scriptures daily, whether those things were so

cases.name: Priscilla and Aquila
cases.charge: Laying down their own necks for Paul’s life; and expounding unto Apollos the way of God more perfectly

cases.name: Apollos
cases.charge: Being instructed in the way of the Lord, and receiving correction from a tentmaker and his wife

cases.name: The Ephesians who burned their books
cases.charge: Confessing and shewing their deeds, and burning fifty thousand pieces of silver worth of curious arts before all men

cases.name: The seven sons of Sceva
cases.charge: Exorcising in the name of Jesus whom Paul preacheth

cases.name: Demetrius and the silversmiths of Ephesus
cases.charge: Raising an uproar over lost trade under the colour of zeal for Diana

cases.name: Ananias the high priest
cases.charge: Commanding Paul to be smitten on the mouth, contrary to the law, while sitting to judge him by the law

cases.name: Felix the governor
cases.charge: Trembling at the judgment to come, hoping for a bribe, and leaving a man he knew to be innocent bound

cases.name: The Corinthian who had his father’s wife
cases.charge: Fornication not so much as named among the Gentiles: a man with his father’s wife

cases.name: The Corinthians at the Lord’s supper
cases.charge: Eating and drinking unworthily; shaming them that have not

cases.name: Epaphroditus
cases.charge: For the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me

cases.name: Timothy, with Lois and Eunice
cases.charge: Unfeigned faith that dwelt first in his grandmother and his mother; knowing the holy scriptures from a child

cases.name: Onesiphorus
cases.charge: Oft refreshing Paul, and not ashamed of his chain; seeking him out very diligently in Rome

cases.name: Hymenaeus, Alexander, and Philetus
cases.charge: Making shipwreck of the faith; blasphemy; teaching that the resurrection is past already

cases.name: Paul, at the end of his course
cases.charge: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith

cases.name: Demas
cases.charge: Forsaking Paul, having loved this present world

cases.name: Alexander the coppersmith
cases.charge: Doing Paul much evil; greatly withstanding his words

cases.name: Gaius, the wellbeloved
cases.charge: Walking in the truth; doing faithfully to the brethren and to strangers; bringing them forward on their journey after a godly sort

cases.name: Diotrephes
cases.charge: Loving the preeminence; prating against the apostle with malicious words; casting the brethren out of the church

cases.name: The churches of Ephesus, Sardis, and Laodicea
cases.charge: Leaving the first love; a name to live while dead; lukewarm, and saying, I am rich

cases.name: Antipas, Smyrna, and Philadelphia
cases.charge: Faithful unto death; keeping the word of his patience; not denying his name in the place where Satan’s seat is

cases.name: The church in Pergamos
cases.charge: Holding among them the doctrine of Balaam and the doctrine of the Nicolaitans

cases.name: Jezebel of Thyatira
cases.charge: Calling herself a prophetess; teaching the servants of God to commit fornication and eat things sacrificed to idols
